FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say the French letter E? (1 mark)
   A. ee
   B. ay
   C. eh
   D. uh

2. What does 'au revoir' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Pleased to meet you
   B. Sir, Mr
   C. goodbye
   D. hi, bye

3. How do you spell the name Amina aloud in French letter names? (1 mark)
   A. ah, en, ee, em, ah
   B. ah, em, ee, en, ah
   C. ay, em, eye, en, ay
   D. ah, em, ee, ah, en

4. How do you say 'My sister is called Njeri.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est ma sœur.
   B. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   C. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   D. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.

5. What does 'la grand-mère' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandmother
   B. the grandfather
   C. the baby
   D. the girl

6. What does 'Où est ... ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sofa
   B. Where is ... ?
   C. the cat
   D. the book

7. What does 'je joue' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. today
   B. I dance
   C. I play
   D. I rest

8. How do you say 'On Saturday, I help my mother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le jeudi, je chante.
   B. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   C. Une semaine, sept jours.
   D. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.

9. What does 'samedi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Saturday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Wednesday

10. What number is 'douze' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 12

11. Which month is 'avril'? (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. April
   C. January
   D. May

12. What does 'un ballon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a month
   B. a song
   C. a candle
   D. a balloon

13. What does 'les frites' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. milk
   B. fruits
   C. fish
   D. chips

14. Which sentence is correct for one orange? (1 mark)
   A. C'est des oranges.
   B. Ce sont un orange.
   C. C'est une orange.
   D. Ce sont une orange.

15. What does 'le pain' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the mango
   B. bread
   C. fruits
   D. juice

16. How do you say 'I have two hands.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux mains.
   B. J'ai un nez.
   C. J'ai deux yeux.
   D. Elle est petite.

17. What does 'le nez' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the stomach
   B. the mouth
   C. the back
   D. the nose

18. How do you say 'It is snowing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a des nuages.
   B. Il neige.
   C. Il fait chaud.
   D. Il pleut.

19. What does 'la neige' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the wind
   B. the weather
   C. the storm
   D. the snow

20. How do you say 'The bed is in the bedroom.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Où est la clé ?
   B. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   C. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   D. Il est sur la table.

21. What does 'tout droit' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to the right
   B. near
   C. to the left
   D. straight ahead

22. How is enchantée said? (1 mark)
   A. en-chan-TEE
   B. en-kan-TAY
   C. ench-ant-EE
   D. on-shon-TAY

23. What does 'J'ai un frère et une sœur.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My father is called David.
   B. My brother is called Kamau.
   C. This is my brother.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

24. What does 'Voici ma famille.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is it?
   B. My sister is called Njeri.
   C. Here is my family.
   D. It is the baby.

25. Which little word goes with 'sœur' (the sister)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. les
   D. le

26. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: How many candles are there? (1 mark)
   A. twelve
   B. five
   C. two
   D. ten

27. What does 'C'est le premier janvier.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   B. It is the first of January.
   C. Thank you very much!
   D. Here is a present for you.

28. What does 'Merci beaucoup !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy birthday!
   B. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   C. I am ten years old.
   D. Thank you very much!

29. What does 'Je bois un jus.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat a mango.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. They are mangoes.
   D. I like the mango.

30. Which little word goes with 'pain' (the bread)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. les
   D. l'

31. What does 'Il pleut.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is windy.
   B. It is raining.
   C. It is cold.
   D. The weather is nice.

32. How do you say 'Sir, Mr' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Monsieur
   B. salut
   C. Enchanté
   D. bonsoir

33. How do you say 'goodbye' in French? (1 mark)
   A. bonjour
   B. au revoir
   C. bien
   D. Enchanté

34. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'brother'? (1 mark)
   A. frere
   B. frére
   C. frère
   D. frèe

35. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'window'? (1 mark)
   A. fene´tre
   B. fenêre
   C. fenêtre
   D. fenetre

36. How do you say 'a birthday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une bougie
   B. un cadeau
   C. un anniversaire
   D. un mois

37. How do you write the number 30 in French? (1 mark)
   A. treize
   B. huit
   C. trente
   D. douze

38. How do you say 'a candle' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une bougie
   B. un anniversaire
   C. un ballon
   D. un mois

39. How do you say 'the shoulder' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le bras
   B. l'épaule
   C. l'oreille
   D. le ventre

40. How do you say 'the sun' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une inondation
   B. le soleil
   C. le nuage
   D. la pluie

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into French: 'In the kitchen, there is a fridge.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'This is my sister.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Name the four French accents you have learned and give an example word for each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'Happy birthday!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'C'est un gâteau.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Voici mon grand-père.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'There is a storm.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux oreilles.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

51. Translate into French: 'It is the first of January.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Translate into English: 'Le lundi, je vais à l'école.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'I like milk.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

54. Translate into English: 'Il fait froid.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Translate into English: 'Allez tout droit.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

56. Translate into French: 'I stay in the house.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'Au revoir, Monsieur.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into English: 'Ce sont des oranges.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Read the family tree: le père Otieno, la mère Njeri, la fille Amina, le garçon Kamau. Write two sentences in French about it. (4 marks) (4 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'It is a banana.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into English: 'Salut, Kamau !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Translate into French: 'I am ten years old.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

63. Translate into English: 'Bon anniversaire !' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — uh
   The letter E is said uh in French.

2. C — goodbye
   au revoir means goodbye.

3. B — ah, em, ee, en, ah
   A is ah, M is em, I is ee, N is en.

4. C — Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   My sister is called Njeri. in French is Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.

5. A — the grandmother
   la grand-mère means the grandmother.

6. B — Where is ... ?
   Où est ... ? means Where is ... ?.

7. C — I play
   je joue means I play.

8. B — Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   On Saturday, I help my mother. in French is Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.

9. B — Saturday
   samedi means Saturday.

10. D — 12
   douze means 12.

11. B — April
   avril means April.

12. D — a balloon
   un ballon means a balloon.

13. D — chips
   les frites means chips.

14. C — C'est une orange.
   One feminine thing: C'est une ...

15. B — bread
   le pain means bread.

16. A — J'ai deux mains.
   I have two hands. in French is J'ai deux mains.

17. D — the nose
   le nez means the nose.

18. B — Il neige.
   It is snowing. in French is Il neige.

19. D — the snow
   la neige means the snow.

20. B — Le lit est dans la chambre.
   The bed is in the bedroom. in French is Le lit est dans la chambre.

21. D — straight ahead
   tout droit means straight ahead.

22. D — on-shon-TAY
   Enchanté and enchantée are said the same: on-shon-TAY.

23. D — I have a brother and a sister.
   J'ai un frère et une sœur. means I have a brother and a sister.

24. C — Here is my family.
   Voici ma famille. means Here is my family.

25. B — la
   sœur is feminine, so we say la sœur.

26. D — ten
   Dix bougies means ten candles.

27. B — It is the first of January.
   C'est le premier janvier. means It is the first of January.

28. D — Thank you very much!
   Merci beaucoup ! means Thank you very much!

29. B — I drink a juice.
   Je bois un jus. means I drink a juice.

30. B — le
   pain is masculine, so we say le pain.

31. B — It is raining.
   Il pleut. means It is raining.

32. A — Monsieur
   Sir, Mr in French is Monsieur.

33. B — au revoir
   goodbye in French is au revoir.

34. C — frère
   The correct spelling is frère, with its accents.

35. C — fenêtre
   The correct spelling is fenêtre, with its accents.

36. C — un anniversaire
   a birthday in French is un anniversaire.

37. C — trente
   30 in French is trente.

38. A — une bougie
   a candle in French is une bougie.

39. B — l'épaule
   the shoulder in French is l'épaule.

40. B — le soleil
   the sun in French is le soleil.
